messages:
maya: heads-up — we just saw a big spike in prometheus remote_write 504s from us-west2 GPU cluster at ~12:32. p95 write latency jumped and queues filled.
oliver: link to grafana? which dashboard?
maya: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/observ/gpu-remotewrite?orgId=1&from=now-1h
infra-bot: alert fired: prometheus.remotewrite.queue_length > 800 (us-west2-gpu)
chloe: hmm did we push any infra changes around that time? nat gw/autoscaler work?
ben: I ran a cost test earlier and scaled nat-gw down to 1 for the region around 12:20 to validate idle-savings.
maya: that lines up. nat-gw down -> connection churn -> lots of TCP TIME_WAIT on sidecars -> remote_write connections fail -> prom retries + series re-registration = cardinality noise
oliver: saw relabeling churn too — exporters re-sent with ephemeral labels, our relabel rules kept some dynamic labels which exploded series count
chloe: immediate mitigation: add a temporary relabel to drop noisy labels from gpu exporters, and increase remote_write timeout. small, targeted change.
ops-lead: agree. Also we should set a min nat-gw=2 for GPU clusters while we stabilize. cost vs availability tradeoff.
ben: cost hit will be ~+$1200/mo per region, but ran the numbers — downtime during promos is worse.
maya: practical steps I propose: 1) apply relabel to drop high-cardinality labels for gpu-exporters 2) bump remote_write timeout to 30s and queue_capacity + shard 3) set nat-gw min replicas=2 4) create runbook and postmortem
oliver: can you paste the relabel snippet you'll apply?
maya: sure — applying as a canary in staging first:
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
    regex: "(gpu-exporter|prom-scraper)"
    action: keep
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_instance_id]
    action: drop
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_ephemeral_id]
    action: replace
    replacement: "<redacted>"
```
chloe: nice. also add a soft cutoff on series per exporter in agent config (prefix_kv_cache_size) so a single flaky exporter can't flood remote_write queue
ben: I'll update terraform for nat-gw min replicas after we validate staging canary
ops-lead: who owns the runbook?
maya: I will draft runbook and include rollback steps & Grafana links. will note cost justification for nat-gw change.
infra-bot: ticket INFRA-4821 created (prom-remotewrite-natgw-churn) by chloe
ben: ping me when the PR is up, I'll review infra changes
maya: PR: https://git.redwood/infracloud/patches/1234 — contains relabel + remote_write timeout bump (staging only)
oliver: thumbs up on PR, will watch staging metrics during canary, will also compare series_count and label_entropy panels
chloe: logging note — we should enable detailed sidecar connection logs for 30m during canary so we can capture tcp/keepalive behavior
ops-lead: schedule postmortem if this reoccurs after changes. assign incident severity if customer impact >5% requests
maya: will update thread with staging results. thanks all :thumbsup:
